triage.fix_rationale: The Angular upgrade (package.json and package-lock.json) is the likely cause of the size change, so check or pin the versions there. If the new size is expected, the initial-bundle budget is set in angular.json. The 13 kB and 15 kB limits look suspiciously small for an Angular app, so check them too.
triage.hypothesis: The Dependabot Angular bump changed the build output, and `npm run build` (run by `npm run lighthouse`) failed because the initial bundle is 266.16 kB. That is far over the configured initial-bundle budget, which is 13 kB for the warning and 15 kB for the error. Lighthouse never ran, because the build step failed first.
